title.zh: 宣布每年2月13日为马尼拉大都会Parañaque市特别工作假日及学校停课日，以纪念其建市纪念日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring February 13 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday and No Class Day in Schools in the City of Parañaque, Metro Manila in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day Anniversary
title.orig: An Act Declaring February 13 of Every Year a Special Working Holiday and No Class Day in Schools in the City of Parañaque, Metro Manila in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day Anniversary

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10807_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: February 13 of every year is declared a special working holiday and no class day in schools in the City of Parañaque, Metro Manila in commemoration of its foundation day anniversary.
For work performed on a special working holiday, an employee is entitled to his/her regular wage.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
